bullets: Post-close, the cleanest nested split is inside Energy: XOM/CVX carry the refining-margin bid while services, drilling, uranium and thermal coal are the weak pockets, so XLE should not be averaged. Consumer Defensive strength is mostly PM/MO smoke-free tobacco, not TPB/UVV leaf exposure. Basic Materials offers only the CENX single-stock catalyst, while met-coal and RVs remain broken. No morning size gate is set yet; overnight futures/calendar can change sizing.
